recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑、脂肪與出血，造血區由密集的單核細胞間質性浸潤取代，巨核細胞不明顯；但這個倍率下看不出腫瘤細胞特徵，無法單靠此圖認出 BPDCN，需搭配高倍與免疫染色。
features: Bone marrow core with a thin bony trabecula and preserved fat spaces
Cellularity moderately increased for age in the hematopoietic areas (estimated about 50–60%)
Dense interstitial and sheet-like mononuclear cell infiltrate between adipocytes
Megakaryocytes not readily identified at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows bony trabeculae with intervening marrow that contains preserved fat and focal hemorrhage. The hematopoietic areas are occupied by a dense interstitial to sheet-like infiltrate of mononuclear cells, with megakaryocytes not readily appreciated. Cytologic detail is insufficient at this magnification to characterize the infiltrate, and the pattern is not specific. Findings are compatible with marrow involvement by a blastic neoplasm; correlation with high-power morphology and immunohistochemistry (CD4, CD56, CD123, TCL1) is required to support blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Low-power architecture is indistinguishable; MPO/CD34/CD117 positivity and TCL1/CD123 profile on IHC separate AML from BPDCN.
Also produces a diffuse interstitial infiltrate; TdT and B/T lineage markers are required.
Normal marrow shows a mix of erythroid islands, maturing granulocytes and scattered megakaryocytes rather than a monotonous mononuclear infiltrate, which needs higher power to confirm.
